_comment: #71 floor modifiers. From floor `from_floor` every floor has one, picked by the party's vote at the previous floor's portal between two offered ones. `danger` / `reward` are the card lines. Numbers: count_mult (monsters per room), elite_mult (elite packs), light_mult (torches, carried torches, the hero's own light; spells keep theirs), xp_mult, drop_mult (monster drop chance and boss drop count), gold_mult, book_mult (lore book chance), rarity_up_chance (share of dropped items lifted one rarity tier, to Epic at most). Restless: standing inside still_radius px for still_time s starts restless stacks (warn_at s first turns the meter red with a sound); each tick adds one stack (status restless_curse) and burns burn_pct of max health, moving clears them. Hunted: a hunter every interval s (first after first s), warned warn s before by a rift; at most max_alive at once; strength scales per extra hero.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.danger: Far more monsters in every room.

elite.name: Elite floor
elite.danger: Many more elite packs, and their altars.

dimmed.name: Dimmed
dimmed.danger: Torches and your own light reach less far.

restless.name: Restless
restless.danger: Stand still for long and the floor burns you.

hunted.name: Hunted
hunted.danger: An elite hunter comes for you every minute or so.
hunted.reward: Every hunter drops a fine item.
